items.heading: Not Every Provider Walks Through
items.text: Not Every Provider Walks Through Not Every Provider Walks Through Not every provider walks through every stage before handing over an answer. This is the difference that matters once a decision has to hold up past the first conversation.

items.heading: There Is No Fixed Weekly
items.text: There Is No Fixed Weekly There is no fixed weekly timetable attached to the sequence, the stages move at the pace your actual decision needs, though students who want the follow-up stage kept current can draw on up to 24 small-group sessions across the year.

items.heading: Every Stage Shares the Same
items.text: Every stage shares the same starting point as a single session, the 1-on-1. What is different is what happens after that first conversation, not what happens inside it.

items.heading: If the Composition, Group Size,
items.text: If the composition, group size, or exact price of each structure matters more right now than how the work flows, the package and fees pages answer that directly instead.

items.heading: Skipping Straight to Action
items.text: Skipping straight to action-planning without the earlier mapping and exploration stages is the more common mistake here than picking the wrong stage to start at.
